simple.meaning: דּוּמָם (dûwmâm) is a Hebrew word meaning “still ; adverbially, silently.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דּוּמָם (H1748) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 47:5, with occurrences in Isaiah, Lamentations, Habakkuk.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דּוּמָם (H1748) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דּוּמָם (H1748) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דּוּמָם (dûwmâm) / H1748 is traced through Isaiah 47:5, Lamentations 3:26, Habakkuk 2:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1748. dumam II. דּוּמָה proper name 1. masculine son of Ishmael Gen 25:15 = 1Chr 1:30 compare probably Dumath al-Jandal in Northern Arabia in Jôf see Burckhardt Travels in Syria 662f. Di; also Ges Comm. on Isa 21:11 , Glaser Skizze ii. 392, 440. 2 city in mountains of Judah Josh 15:52 , compare Δοῦμα in the Daroma, 17 miles from Eleutheropolis Lag Onom. 250. 2nd ed. 258 , = modern Daume , southwest from Hebron van de Velde Memoir 308 Guérin Judée iii. 359 ff. compare Di. 3 name of Edom with mystic meaning Isa 21:11 Duma = silence of death, desolation, De Che and others (JDMich Ges Hi think 31 ; ᵐ5 has Ἰδουμαια ; Jerome interprets as part of Idumea; still another view below I. דּוּמָה ). דּוּמָם noun [masculine] silence Hab 2:19 ד ׳אֶבֶן stone of silence = dumb stone ; adverb in silence, silently , Isa 47:5 ; Lam 3:26 (? read here וְרָמַם from דמם ). דּוּמֶּ֫שֶׂק 2Kin 16:10 compare דַּמֶּשֶׂק .

occurrences.englishText: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness,
It is good that a man should hope
Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
